_README: Competition history shown on the home page timeline. Only years with real, confirmed details are listed — add a year back by copying an entry below and filling it in. Set `needsReview: true` while an entry is still incomplete and the site will show a small 'details still need to be filled in' note. See docs/UPDATING_THE_TEAM.md.

years.blurb: Our best result to date. Competing against more than 400 teams from 48 countries, the team built a platform leveraging AI to counter antibiotic-resistant superbugs, placing in the top 10 of the overgraduate category. 2024 was also the first year iGEM Toronto fielded a formal entrepreneurship team, which went on to compete in the U of T Entrepreneurship Hatchery's Demo Week.

years.project: Early detection of Oak Wilt disease
years.blurb: To help conserve wildlife affected by Oak Wilt — a fungal disease caused by B. fagacearum — the team proposed an on-site early diagnostic tool that lets foresters identify infected oak trees in time to slow the spread. Presented at the Giant Jamboree in Paris alongside 346 teams from 45 countries.

years.project: Accelerating Industrial Plastic Degradation With PETase
years.blurb: The team engineered PETase to accelerate the breakdown of industrial plastic waste, earning Gold Medal standard at the Giant Jamboree in Boston — our first gold since 2013 — and a nomination for Best Manufacturing Project, placing the project in the top five of its track.
